item.title: ARTIST RECEPTION Just Around The Corner - Paintings by Bill Gittins — Sat Nov 7, 12:00 PM — Rena Charles Gallery
item.description:
Meet the Artist Reception Saturday, November 7th from Noon - 4pm at Rena Charles Gallery located at 439 Healdsburg Ave, Healdsburg.
Just Around The Corner - Palette knife paintings by Bill Gittins
Rooted in the landscape of Sonoma County, Bill Gittins paints with an eye for color, movement, and the energy of a passing moment. Working in oil with both brush and palette knife, he finds his subjects close to home: vineyards and rolling hills, country roads and winding trails, weathered barns, coastal bluffs, crashing waves and retreating tides, and skies that shift from drifting clouds to blazing sunsets. These scenes become more than features of the natural world; they invite the eye to wander and the imagination to follow. Like the paths we take in life, his roads and trails lead toward possibilities just out of view, and toward whatever waits around the next bend.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
